newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end up on short covering.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end up on short covering.

text.p: Pakistani stocks finished higher on Wednesday amid short-covering prompted by speculative buying in select blue chips, dealers said.
"Speculative buying in Hub Power on the back of market talk of foreign interest in this blue chip prompted short-covering," dealer Salman Ahmed of Finex Securities said.
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index rose 4.15 points, or 0.31 percent, to close at 1,345.46. Losers led gainers 133 to 92. Hub Power Co rose 0.40 to 32.25 but PTCL fell 0.25 to 23.60.
In the present political uncertainty, slight gains should not be regarded as a sign of rebound, the dealer said. Stock prices were likely to open mixed on Thursday.
HUBCO rose 0.15 to 32.25 rupees, ICI Pakistan 0.25 to 17.70, Dawood Hercules 5.00 to 125 and Sui Northern Gas 0.85 to 32. Parke Davis fell 5.00 to 495.
